queries.query: Placing foam fractionation within a PFAS treatment train. Prepare a focused review of when foam fractionation is useful as a concentration step and how the resulting PFAS-rich foamate should be managed.
Compare evidence from laboratory, pilot, and commercial applications for different feed waters and PFAS profiles.
Assess short-chain PFAS recovery, achievable volume reduction, stability of operation, and energy demand.
Evaluate downstream treatment or disposal of foamate and identify conditions under which the overall treatment train is advantageous.
